objective_value: <float> Total cost over the planning horizon, summing all fixed setup costs incurred and all per-unit holding costs charged at every facility in every period.
x_plant: <list[float], length num_periods> Quantity produced at the plant in each period.
s_plant: <list[float], length num_periods> Inventory held at the plant at the end of each period.
y_plant: <list[int], length num_periods> Whether the plant is set up to produce in each period (1 = yes, 0 = no).
x_warehouses: <list[list[float]], shape [num_warehouses][num_periods]> Quantity shipped from the plant to each warehouse in each period.
s_warehouses: <list[list[float]], shape [num_warehouses][num_periods]> Inventory held at each warehouse at the end of each period.
y_warehouses: <list[list[int]], shape [num_warehouses][num_periods]> Whether each warehouse is set up to receive a shipment in each period (1 = yes, 0 = no).
x_retailers: <list[list[float]], shape [num_retailers][num_periods]> Quantity shipped from the assigned warehouse to each retailer in each period.
s_retailers: <list[list[float]], shape [num_retailers][num_periods]> Inventory held at each retailer at the end of each period.
y_retailers: <list[list[int]], shape [num_retailers][num_periods]> Whether each retailer is set up to receive a shipment in each period (1 = yes, 0 = no).
